items.title: OpenAI rolls GPT-6.2 Sol into ChatGPT Chat; GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra retire Dec 23
items.summary: GPT-6.2 Sol, tuned for everyday conversation, reached ChatGPT Chat for paid tiers on Nov 23. OpenAI set Dec 23 as the retirement date for GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra.
items.whyItMatters: A conversation-tuned model that is replacing older ones is worth testing as the text brain behind Romain/Anna, and the retirement date matters if either agent pins a model.

items.title: inclusionAI quietly uploads Ling-3.2-Air: 124B MoE, 5.5B active, 1M context, MIT
items.summary: inclusionAI posted Ling-3.2-Air to Hugging Face on Nov 23 with no announcement. It is a 124B mixture-of-experts model with 5.5B active parameters and a 1M context window, under an MIT license.
items.whyItMatters: Few active parameters under a permissive license could make self-hosted tutor logic cheaper. French quality is untested.

items.title: AWS Strands Decider v2: open-weight decision models on Gemma 4 (Apache 2.0)
items.summary: AWS released five open-weight decision models built on Gemma 4, from edge size up to 31B, as part of its Strands agent updates on Nov 23.
items.whyItMatters: Small routing or decision models are a pattern for deciding when the tutor should correct, switch topic or hand off, without calling a large LLM each turn.

items.title: Apple starts Siri AI rollout across eight apps, with a third-party App Intents preview
items.summary: Siri AI features are shipping in eight Apple apps, and a TestFlight-only developer preview lets third-party apps plug in via App Intents. It is unavailable in the EU.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing if the tutor ever needs a hands-free, system-level voice entry point on iOS.
